name: v0.12.0
body:
# Rows ’n’ Calls + Some Fixes This release has a nice quality-of-life feature and some bugfixes. Let's check it out. ## New! `Rows` and `Cols` Now you can set the output size the 1980s way: using rows and columns. This is an alternative to using pixels. ```vhs Output examples/settings/columns.gif Set Height 400 Set Columns 30 Set FontSize 32 # A count from 1 to 30, one digit per column, touches the left and # right edges of the frame exactly with no wrap: 30 columns. Hide Type "clear; echo 123456789012345678901234567890" Show Sleep 1s Enter Sleep 2s ``` Special thanks to star contributor and longtime community member @DaltonSW for the feature. ## Fixed * VHS action: fixed in [v2.1.1](https://github.com/charmbracelet/vhs-action/releases/tag/v2.1.1). Make sure to check that out with this VHS version (`v0.12.0`)! * Windows command console non longer hangs. Enjoy a hang free Windows VHS experience! That's all for now, Best of luck, Charm XX ☀️ ## Changelog ### New! * f48d79b482296f40b857d555d535d0dc43a70cb0: feat(cli): assume .tape extension in filename arg if omitted (#654) (@DaltonSW) * f0761c04f6096baf43d8a39f008fe31c0c5c55da: feat: rows/cols for axises (#763) (@DaltonSW) ### Fixed * 42f1776e6dce45ef3d711118ba799e1cbd385e00: fix(windows): chrome process idle no rendering (#781) (@andrinoff) * 3294be00fcc19a8f16c3eff994bc0d985cc508db: fix: bump go to 1.26.7 (#784) (@andrinoff) ### Docs * 0a2c15eab702062a2044816729ba2c356ab47687: docs: fix README grammar (@rohan436) ### Other stuff * 3546c13f022f7db55fd949b430439bf6af463734: ci: sync dependabot config (#776) (@charmcli) * 6f0c046e6bcaeada9749e08367b745b5c5cbfd3d: ci: sync golangci-lint config (#723) (@github-actions[bot]) * db96d7374f7d7a3774f69a43f4fcc5c5a1fd74e3: v0.12.0 (@andrinoff) ---
Verifying the artifacts First, download the [`checksums.txt` file](https://github.com/charmbracelet/vhs/releases/download/v0.12.0/checksums.txt) and the [`checksums.txt.sigstore.json` file](https://github.com/charmbracelet/vhs/releases/download/v0.12.0/checksums.txt.sigstore.json) files, for example, with `wget`: ```bash wget 'https://github.com/charmbracelet/vhs/releases/download/v0.12.0/checksums.txt' wget 'https://github.com/charmbracelet/vhs/releases/download/v0.12.0/checksums.txt.sigstore.json' ``` Then, verify it using [`cosign`](https://github.com/sigstore/cosign): ```bash cosign verify-blob \ --certificate-identity 'https://github.com/charmbracelet/meta/.github/workflows/goreleaser.yml@refs/heads/main' \ --certificate-oidc-issuer 'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' \ --bundle 'checksums.txt.sigstore.json' \ ./checksums.txt ``` If the output is `Verified OK`, you can safely use it to verify the checksums of other artifacts you downloaded from the release using `sha256sum`: ```bash sha256sum --ignore-missing -c checksums.txt ``` Done! You artifacts are now verified!
